caption: A mechanical metronome is set going, and its pendulum swings from side to side with each tick.

sa.check: It is set going: a hand releases or starts the pendulum.
The pendulum swings from side to side.
The swing is steady and repeated.
The start comes first and the swinging follows.

pc.expect: The pendulum is still before the start, then swings about its pivot at the base while the body stays still.
pc.fail: The pendulum swings before it is started; or the body rocks or walks across the table; or the weight slides up or down the rod on its own; or the rod bends mid-swing.

pc.expect: While running, the swing keeps a steady width and reverses at each end.
pc.fail: The arcs shrink to a stop with nothing touching the metronome; or grow wider and wider; or the pendulum pauses in mid-swing and then continues; or it stops dead at one side with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: The pendulum passes the centre at speed and slows toward each end; both sides mirror each other.
pc.fail: The pendulum moves in jerks; or jumps from one side to the other without passing the centre; or swings in a circle rather than side to side.

pc.expect: The rod, the weight and the body are rigid.
pc.fail: The rod bends; or the body flexes; or the weight changes shape.

pc.expect: One metronome with one pendulum; nothing passes through the case.
pc.fail: A second pendulum appears; or the pendulum vanishes; or passes through the case; or the metronome turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The case's colour, the scale markings and the weight's colour stay the same.
pc.fail: The case changes colour; or the scale markings change; or the weight changes colour.

note: The hand that starts it is a trigger and is not judged.
